bridgeVersion.description: The bridge version the CURRENT template implements. A shell reports its own; the facade compares the two, because the web ships in minutes and an APK ships when the user reinstalls it.

flavours.description: Which shell template flavours CARRY a capability, by capability name. A capability absent here is in every trusted flavour (full and the heavier ones); one listed here is granted only by the flavours named — the engine's `godot` lives only in the template that links the engine. The template generator derives each flavour's grant list from this, so no list is typed by hand.

id.description: capability.method — the wire name and the facade key.

capability.description: Permission group and bridge flag. The registry in docs/research/apk-sdk-plan.md §3.

kind.description: call = request/response. subscribe = a native-pushed stream until cancelled; without it every streaming capability degenerates into polling across the bridge.

minBridge.description: Oldest shell that implements this action.

android.description: Android permissions the action needs, unprefixed (CAMERA, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION).

args.description: JSON Schema for the argument object.

result.description: JSON Schema for the resolved value.

mock.description: Deterministic value the facade returns under the gate, so the has-bridge branch of every app is exercised in Chromium — which never runs the APK.
